Cc: Acme EU Billing <billing@acme-eu.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Final invoice for Redwood account – VAT charge query

Hi Kim,

Thanks for sending over the end-of-term invoice this morning. We reviewed it with Finance and have one blocking item: the invoice includes Italian VAT at 22%, but Acme EU is VAT-registered and the reverse-charge should apply for this cross-border B2B supply. Our VAT number is IT12345678901 (I've attached the VAT certificate).

Can you please:
- Reissue the invoice without VAT (reverse-charge) or provide a credit note + corrected invoice?
- Ensure the legal entity on the invoice is "Acme EU S.r.l." (our procurement team needs exact match)
- Confirm whether Redwood can include SEPA details for payment (our treasury needs IBAN/beneficiary name).

We are ready to release final payment once the paperwork is corrected. Ideally we'd have the corrected invoice before EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: acme_vat_certificate.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Finance Operations, Acme EU
elena.rossi@acme-eu.com
+39 02 1234 5678

Hi Elena,

Thanks — I see your certificate, appreciate the quick turnaround. I will run this with Finance + Tax and get a corrected set of documents issued.

Quick questions to speed this up:
- Confirm legal name to appear on corrected invoice: "Acme EU S.r.l." (as requested above)?
- Do you need the credit note split (credit first, then reissue) or a single reissued invoice is fine for your AP process?

Rafael — can you confirm our process and timeline to issue a credit note and a new invoice without VAT under reverse-charge? If we can get this out today or tomorrow morning that should keep their payment on track.

I'll send the documents to Acme's billing contact and cc you.

Kim / team,

We can handle this. Process we will follow:
1) Issue credit note referencing original invoice RIF-INV-4931 (credit note CN-4931) to nullify the VAT-inclusive invoice.
2) Reissue invoice RIF-INV-4931-ACME-20270310 with net amount and a VAT note: "Reverse charge – VAT to be accounted for by the customer (Article 44)".
3) Validate the VAT number against VIES (done) and attach the validation screenshot to the credit note.

I'll prepare the credit note draft and the reissued invoice in finance system and send for electronic signature if needed. ETA: draft CN + reissued invoice within 4 hours.

Marissa — please confirm beneficiary/SEPA details to include (we should use Redwood Inference Ltd, GB account) and whether we need our company registration number on the invoice for Acme's AP.

I'll attach the draft credit note here for review.

Attachment: RIF-CreditNote-4931.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
